name: ai-regression-studio
description: AI-powered GWT to React regression testing platform

scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/shared-contracts && npm run build -w packages/test-schemas && npm run build -w apps/browser-worker && npm run build -w apps/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w packages/shared-contracts && npm run test -w packages/test-schemas && npm run test -w apps/browser-worker && npm run test -w apps/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w packages/shared-contracts && npm run typecheck -w packages/test-schemas && npm run typecheck -w apps/browser-worker && npm run typecheck -w apps/web
